basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old software developer based in Portland, Maine, with a passion for gaming and building custom PCs. When I'm not coding, you can find me hanging out with my Maine Coon, Luna, or tinkering with home automation projects. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and during weekends. I’m in a long-term relationship with my partner, who shares my love for video games and cats.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working as a software developer for over a decade. I've always had a keen interest in technology and gaming, which led me to self-teach advanced programming and game development skills. My expertise is further bolstered by my experience in building custom PCs, both for gaming and professional use.
